newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand sets five-year cane sugar output target.
newsitem.headline: Thailand sets five-year cane sugar output target.

text.p: Thailand said on Monday it has targeted cane sugar output of 60 million tonnes per year for the seasons from 1997/98 (Nov-Oct) to 2001/2002.
The latest target exceeds the 55 million tonnes target set for the past five years which began in 1992/93, an industry ministry document said.
The target for sugar (raw value) output was put at 7.2 million tonnes per year for the same period compared with 6.6 million tonnes in the corresponding five-year period, the ministry added.
Thailand's crushed some 57.68 million tonnes of cane at its mills during the 1995-96 (November-June) crushing season against 50.46 million tonnes a year ago, the ministry said.
